# xbrl_concept_map.md — Ask My Filings

**Status:** Placeholder skeleton (Phase 0). Populated and hand-verified in Phase 3 against real filing data (Apple, CIK 0000320193) — per Hard Constraint 12, these values are never auto-generated by a coding tool.

## Purpose

Maps the required `us-gaap:*` XBRL concepts to the six dashboard ratios' inputs. Consumed by `backend/xbrl/concept_map.py` (execution plan Part 3, Phase 3).

## Reconciliation identities (AD-014)

- `AssetsCurrent + AssetsNoncurrent = Assets`
- `Liabilities + StockholdersEquity = Assets`

Mismatch flags `reconciled = FALSE` — must surface as a visible data-quality flag, never silently accepted.
